title: How Data Scales in Agentic Reinforcement Learning: Laws and Synthesis Strategies
abstract: arXiv:2610.23946v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Pretraining scaling laws treat training data as a one-dimensional quantity: a token count. Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) inherits this scalar abstraction, but modern synthesis pipelines now generate \textit{tasks}, \textit{environments}, and \textit{trajectories} independently and at very different costs, turning data into a structured design space. This raises a question pretraining never had to answer: given a synthesis budget, \textit{which axis} should be scaled? We address this question end-to-end with three tightly coupled contributions. First, we decompose agentic data into three cardinality axes (task, environment, trajectory), plus a reward-density control variable, and fit per-axis scaling relations on different large language models (LLMs) across math+code, SWE, web, and UI/tool application domains. translated_title: 智能体强化学习中数据的扩展规律：定律与合成策略
translated_abstract: 预训练的缩放定律将训练数据视为一个一维量：即token数量。智能体强化学习继承了这种标量式的抽象，但现代数据合成流水线如今能够以截然不同的成本独立生成任务、环境和轨迹，使数据变成了一个结构化的设计空间。这引出了一个预训练从未需要回答的问题：在给定的合成预算下，应该扩展哪一个维度？我们通过三项紧密关联的贡献对这一问题进行了端到端的解答。首先，我们将智能体数据分解为三个基数维度（任务、环境、轨迹），外加一个奖励密度控制变量，并在数学+代码、软件工程（SWE）、网页以及UI/工具等应用领域的不同大语言模型（LLM）上拟合了各维度的缩放关系。在我们测量的所有模型规模、模型家族、领域以及强化学习算法（PPO和GRPO）中，缩放指数……
tldr: 该论文将智能体强化学习的训练数据分解为任务、环境和轨迹三个可独立扩展的维度，并拟合出各维度的缩放定律，以回答在给定合成预算下应优先扩展哪个数据维度这一关键问题。
en_tdlr: The paper decomposes agentic RL training data into three independently scalable axes—tasks, environments, and trajectories—and fits per-axis scaling laws to answer which data dimension should be scaled under a fixed synthesis budget.
